description: Products that fit a given product: shower trays for a shower enclosure, walk-in screen or niche door, and enclosures, screens or doors for a shower tray. compatibility.status: fits (fits as is), fits_after_cut (a cuttable tray is cut to size), floor_only (no tray fits: the screen goes on the tiled floor only), unknown (data missing, never present it as a match), not_applicable (we do not track compatibility for this product type). Each returned product has metadata.compatibility with the evaluated variant sku, verdict, reason code and a message in the shop language. Results are capped per role and total is the full count; to narrow a long list use search_catalog with a query and filters.compatible_with.

id.description: Product ID (Shoptet GUID) or variant SKU.

limit.description: Products per role (the server caps it).
